relevance_note: Single-patient case report of a clinically and biochemically diagnosed Tangier disease patient ('A diagnosis of Tangier disease was ascertained.'); no ABCA1 variant, as 'Genetic testing could not be undertaken in our patient'.
method_note: Read by hand; a short Python script only assembled the JSON and checked spans/fields. One in-scope person (label 'patient', rule 5). No variants rows: the paper ties no ABCA1 variant to the patient (genetic testing not done), so n_patients_reported is null (no patient with a ABCA1 variant; one patient with a clinical/biochemical Tangier diagnosis). Age at onset not recorded: the paper gives symptom durations ('of 4 years duration' at age 43), not an age at onset; no age arithmetic done. Tonsil colour 'was ambiguous', so the tonsil checklist item is not reported. Hemogram, ESR, liver/renal tests, Doppler of neck vessels, echocardiography, abdominal ultrasound, autoantibody profile and audiometry were reported normal as whole investigations; recorded as excluded abnormal investigations only, so thrombocytopenia, reticulocytosis and non-coronary atherosclerosis stay not reported. Corneal opacity excluded from 'Slit-lamp examination for corneal fat deposits ... were normal'. Hepatomegaly and splenomegaly excluded from 'did not have organomegaly on clinical or sonological examination'. Hypertriglyceridemia observed and low LDL excluded from values relative to the paper's printed reference ranges (TG 185, ref 50-150; LDL 110, ref 60-160); the paper does not separately call these high or normal. Kinesthetic sensation intact recorded as excluded feature, but 'reduced deep sensation' checklist left not reported (narrower absence). Coronary artery disease not reported (no angiogram; only absence of symptoms). Tables 1-4 are titles only in the Markdown (no table content); Table 3 electrophysiology values are not available. cites_prior_report_of_same_patients left null: the paper does not say this patient was reported before. No contradictions found; note the paper's 'ABCD1 activity' in Section 4 appears to be a typo but was not used.
